properties.description:
Existing recorded check runs are visible in the graph preparation. This remaining stage integrates the approved attempt model and authoritative acceptance relationships. 

Project actual check attempts/results from their owning model into the task execution graph with Broccoli as executor. Preserve exact source revision, prerequisite/gate relationships, result and attempt history. Distinguish failed, stale, cancelled and interrupted runs; never satisfy acceptance with invalid evidence. Reuse declared check discovery, including check:types in each repository. No duplicate check truth or pretend task completion. Critical criteria 1, 5, 12–13.
properties.title: Integrate check attempts and evidence into task execution
